Name: Goth Friendly
Author: Ralodosmovo
Description:
[b]6/6/26:[/b] I'm aware that this mod is no longer working but it's been years since I've touched Stardew modding and I don't plan on getting back into it. However, if you're a content creator wanting to do a playthrough with this mod, I can look into seeing about getting it updated so it can work. Best way to reach out to me is via my email which is listed on my profile.

TO WORK WITH THE LATEST UPDATE, MAKE SURE YOU HAVE THE LATEST VERSIONS OF CONTENT PATCHER AND SMAPI.

This mod turns the UI and player aesthetics gothic. It also changes a lot of the NPCs to be goth or alternative. Everything the player gets will be goth but not everything in the game will be changed. The purpose of this mod is to make the game more goth friendly. This mod comes with several text files such as Notes & Bugs, Mod Log, and Setup & Credits.

Changes the following to be gothy/gothic
- UI (User interface)
- All farm buildings and houses for the player/s
- Most furniture the player gets and can obtain. (See Notes text for more info.)
- All obtainable wallpaper and flooring
- Many craftable items
- Iridium and Iridium tools/weapons
- Some NPC bedrooms
- A few outdoor props

CROP / FORGABLE QUALITY
- Silver Star = Purple Ankh
- Gold Star = Silver Ankh
- Iridium Star = Black Ankh

BONUS
- Functional Goth Card
- Custom, compatible texture for Downtown Zuzu mod's teleporter

FARMER SPRITE CHANGES
- Black rendered shirts
- Black rendered hats and gothy head accessories
- 12 altered goth/alternative hairstyles

MISC CHANGES
- Grandpa Intro Scene
- Blacker cat
- Black goat, sheep, rabbit, and pig
- Black animal products
- Some crop/forgable/item color renders
- Penny & Sebastian like alcohol
- Hat Mouse has a portrait
- Hat Mouse sells goth hats

MISC STRING CHANGES
- Calico Egg = Gothic Coin
- Statue names for altered statues

SPOUSE APPEARANCE CHANGES
- Alex / Emo
- Elliott / Romantic Goth
- Harvey / Plague Dr
- Sam / Punk
- Sebastian / Trad Goth
- Shane / Punk Goth
- Abigail / Trad Goth
- Emily / Alternative
- Haley / Romantic Goth
- Maru / Pastel Goth / Plague Nurse
- Penny / Deathrock
- Krobus / Human Shape
- Leah / Alternative

This mod has a ton of Easter Eggs, both goth related and other. More info can be found on the Mod Log txt file as well as the other txt files. The Notes & Bugs text has a list of the several bugs as well as a Disclaimer. Full credits can be seen on the SETUP & CREDITS txt.

COMPATIBILITY
- Works with other mods though advised to not use with other aesthetic mods.
- Specifically made to be compatible with the Stardew Valley Expanded mod! (If you don't use that mod I highly recommend using it with this.)

Other Required Mods:
ThemeManager
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14525
(This is so the text shows properly. Without it, the text is very ugly, hard to read and doesn't match the UI theme.)
